# Scores

This folder groups numerical scoring systems and assessment tools used to stratify patient risk, predict mortality, and evaluate clinical severity in the context of acute surgery. It currently contains a single sub-folder dedicated to clinical assessment models, which catalogs instruments ranging from general anesthesia classifications to procedure-specific prognostic tools and evaluates their practical utility for national quality indicators.

## Pages

- [[entities/scores/clinical-assessment/index|Clinical Assessment]] — Clinical scoring systems and risk stratification tools, such as ASA, APACHE, and Charlson, evaluated for their utility in acute surgery quality indicators.
